comment: Contract C4. Fixed mapping for everything served from mgmt-git01. Account names are not here: the role renders them from the inventory into dash.json (scrub.accounts), so they stay out of exported code. Pattern rules (addresses, MAC, PCI, UUID, 32-hex point ids, 16-hex lease ids, pod-name hashes, the tailnet name, /home and /projects paths) are in prace_dash_common.py.
